headline: Public hearings on liquor license renewals and a new Isla Express license at 584 Smithfield Avenue.
summary: Most of the agenda is license renewals for food, drink, and entertainment businesses. It also covers new license petitions, a Sunday food and beer event on High Street, and a postponed hearing for Isla Express.
items: Consent agenda: one new door-to-door license and six peddler licenses
Consent agenda: two new First Class food licenses, one with outdoor seating
Consent agenda: many food and tavern license renewals
Public hearing on liquor license renewals for December 2, 2026 to December 1, 2027, Class A
Class T license renewals for four businesses
Public hearing on Class B liquor and victualler renewals, including entertainment and pool table licenses
Class D renewals for clubs, including one veterans club
Entertainment and Class F-1 beer and wine petition for Ora Di Kafe at 120 High Street on Sundays, November 22 and December 20, 2026
Continued public hearing on new Class B victualler license for Isla Express, 584 Smithfield Avenue, postponed from October 21, 2026
New Year's morning 2027: Class B liquor establishments may stay open until 3:00 a.m.
location: City Council Chambers, Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street
